We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case involves buying and illegally providing others' credit card information. The charge is "收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息罪". In Chinese criminal law, that is a specific offense: "非法获取、出售或者提供信用卡信息罪" (illegal acquisition, sale, or provision of credit card information). Also "收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息" is the same. So the crime is "非法获取、出售或者提供信用卡信息罪". The examples show they label as "收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息". In previous examples, they used "收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息". For example earlier: "王4某... 盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". They list multiple crimes separated by semicolons. Here only one crime. So answer: [罪名]收买、非法提供他人信用卡信息<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes like fraud? They mention fraud of 1.689 million using fake police. But that is done by a victim? Actually the fraud was done by others using his card. The defendants are involved in credit card info scheme. The main charge is illegal acquisition and provision of credit card info. So single crime.
